verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents an official hosted remote MCP server (AgentOS MCP at https://mcp.airwallex.com/mcp) with OAuth authentication, safety guardrails, and explicit connection instructions for MCP clients like Claude Code, plus a separate Developer MCP for docs/sandbox integration work — both first-party and independently probed as live docs. Missing for 10: independent hands-on third-party verification of the MCP server actually working end-to-end beyond vendor docs and a probe confirming the doc page exists.
